name: SiteGPT – AI Chatbot
author: sitegpt

sections.description:
Transform your website with SiteGPT’s intelligent AI chatbot. Provide instant customer support, capture leads, and engage visitors 24/7 with advanced conversational AI.

Features:
* Simple one-field configuration
* Automatic script injection
* No coding required
* Works with any theme
* Lightweight and fast
* Mobile responsive
* Customizable appearance
* 24/7 customer support
* Lead generation capabilities
* Analytics and insights

Perfect for e-commerce stores, service businesses, and content creators looking to improve user experience and customer engagement.

Get started with a free account at https://sitegpt.ai

External Services

This plugin connects to SiteGPT’s external service to provide AI chatbot functionality on your website.

What the service is: SiteGPT is a third-party AI chatbot service that provides intelligent conversational interfaces for websites.

What data is sent: When visitors interact with the chatbot, their messages, session data, and potentially IP addresses are sent to SiteGPT’s servers to generate AI responses. The plugin loads JavaScript from https://sitegpt.ai/widget/[chatbot-id].js to enable this functionality.

When data is sent: Data is transmitted when:
– The chatbot widget loads on your pages
– Visitors send messages through the chat interface
– The AI generates responses to user queries

Service links:
– Terms of Service: https://sitegpt.ai/terms
– Privacy Policy: https://sitegpt.ai/privacy

How to find your Chatbot ID

  1. Log in to your SiteGPT dashboard at https://sitegpt.ai
  2. Select your chatbot from the dashboard
  3. Look for the “Chatbot ID” section
  4. Copy the ID (it looks like: 12345678-abcd-1234-abcd-123456789abc)
  5. Paste it into the WordPress plugin settings
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/sitegpt directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings -> SiteGPT to configure the plugin
  4. Enter your SiteGPT chatbot ID (see instructions below)
  5. Save settings and your chatbot will appear on your site
sections.faq:
Where do I find my chatbot ID?

Your chatbot ID is prominently displayed in your SiteGPT dashboard:
– Go to https://sitegpt.ai and log in
– Select your chatbot
– Look for the “Chatbot ID” section with a copy button
– The ID is a unique string like “12345678-abcd-1234-abcd-123456789abc”

Will this work with my theme?

Yes, the plugin is designed to work with any WordPress theme as it injects the chatbot script into the footer.

Is there any impact on site performance?

The plugin is very lightweight and the chatbot script loads asynchronously, so there’s minimal impact on your site’s performance.

Does this plugin collect any data?

The plugin itself doesn’t collect data, but the SiteGPT chatbot service may collect visitor chat data to provide functionality. Please review SiteGPT’s privacy policy and update your site’s privacy policy accordingly.

Does this plugin make external requests?

Yes, this plugin loads JavaScript from https://sitegpt.ai/widget/[chatbot-id].js to display the chatbot. This is necessary for the plugin’s core functionality.
